title: Farming with a Degree Attached
subtitle: 农业与粮食 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 农业与粮食（自然生态·农业与粮食）
meta: 主题语境：农业与粮食（自然生态·农业与粮食）　|　核心词汇：agriculture　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 agriculture 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my uncle was the first in the family to study ① agriculture, which my grandfather called the only subject you can already do, and they did not speak about it for five years. He said ② agriculture is not farming, and my grandfather said it is farming with a degree attached, and neither of them was wrong; agriculture, my uncle said, is the study of what farming does to a man.

The ③ Ministry of Agriculture wrote to him in 1959, offering a job nine miles from the farm, and he said the letter was the first thing the word had ever done for anybody in the family. There was ④ modern agriculture in the book he was given, by which he meant tractors, and there was the farm, by which he meant his father, and the two had nothing to do with each other; agriculture, he wrote home, is a subject that ends at the gate.

He came back in 1961 and said the ⑤ agriculture he had been taught would ruin the farm in five years, and my grandfather said the farm had been ruined since 1931 and had not noticed. They agreed on the ⑥ agriculture policy of the county, which neither of them had read, and disagreed about everything else until 1974; agriculture, my grandmother said, is what they argued about when they were arguing about him.

The  agriculture of the valley, meaning forty-one farms and one river, was gone by 1984, and my uncle said the word should be used only about places and never about people. He had ⑦ a degree in agriculture and a job in an office by then, and he said the degree had been the cheaper of the two mistakes; agriculture, he said, is the only subject you can leave.

The  agriculture I would put in a book, if I ever wrote one, is the five years they did not speak and the one letter from the ministry. ⑧ Agriculture and industry, my uncle wrote in 1990, are the same thing said about different people, and the agriculture of that valley, which is now a road, is the only kind anybody in our family has ever understood.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 农耕（方式）；农业生产
C. n. 农艺；耕作技术
E. 固定搭配：the Ministry of Agriculture 农业部
F. 固定搭配：modern / traditional agriculture 现代／传统农业
G. 固定搭配：agriculture and industry 农业与工业
H. 固定搭配：a degree in agriculture 农学学位

items.q: to study agriculture, which my grandfather
The Ministry of Agriculture wrote to him
There was modern agriculture in the book
the agriculture he had been taught
the agriculture policy of the county
a degree in agriculture and a job
Agriculture and industry, my uncle wrote

answers.why: agriculture 意为“农学、农业”，1954 年叔叔是家里第一个学农学的，祖父说那是唯一一门你本来就会的学科。
agriculture 意为“农艺、耕作技术”，他说农艺不等于种地，祖父说那是附带一个学位的种地。
the Ministry of Agriculture 意为“农业部”，1959 年农业部写信给他，在离农场九英里的地方给他一份工作。
modern agriculture 意为“现代农业”，他拿到的书里讲的是现代农业，意思就是拖拉机。
agriculture 意为“农耕方式、农业生产”，他说自己学的那套农耕方式会在五年内毁掉农场。
agriculture 作定语，意为“农业的”，他们在县里的农业政策上意见一致，而那份政策两人谁也没读过。
a degree in agriculture 意为“农学学位”，那时他已有农学学位和一份办公室工作。
agriculture and industry 意为“农业与工业”，1990 年他写道，这两者是同一件事，只是说的人不同。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年叔叔是家里第一个学农学的，祖父说那是唯一一门你本来就会的学科。（agriculture）
他说农艺不等于种地；祖父说，那是附带一个学位的种地。（agriculture）
1959 年农业部写信给他，在离农场九英里的地方给他一份工作。（the Ministry of Agriculture）
他拿到的书里讲的是现代农业，意思就是拖拉机。（modern agriculture）
到 1984 年他已有农学学位和一份办公室工作，他说学位是两个错误中较便宜的那个。（a degree in agriculture）
1990 年他写道，农业与工业是同一件事，只是说的人不同。（Agriculture and industry）
answers: In 1954 my uncle was the first in the family to study agriculture, the only subject you can already do.
He said agriculture is not farming, and my grandfather said it is farming with a degree attached.
The Ministry of Agriculture wrote to him in 1959, offering a job nine miles from the farm.
There was modern agriculture in the book he was given, by which he meant tractors.
By 1984 he had a degree in agriculture and a job in an office, and he said the degree was the cheaper mistake.
Agriculture and industry, my uncle wrote in 1990, are the same thing said about different people.
